dedupe_keys.name: electricity distribution network data for a topological investigation

description: Electricity distribution network data for a topological investigation is a data set deposited in Cardiff University by its authors S Abeysinghe, J Wu. An investigation of the topological properties of the real-world electricity distribution networks was conducted using real network data that was collected from China, covering urban and sub-urban areas. The study was focused on the 10kV level of the distribution networks. Coverage: national (CN); the metadata date the deposit to 2017. Formats: Excel. Size stated: <100MB. It is reached through its DOI or landing page, listed on this page. Access is free of charge and open according to the repository. The licence is not stated (no licence in the DataCite metadata read on 2026-09-29). Caveats: written from the DataCite metadata (title, abstract, subjects and rights) read on 2026-09-29; the deposit itself was not opened or downloaded, so its contents, quality and current availability were not checked. It can support power-system, energy-planning and grid-operation studies. Related records: none catalogued yet for this repository.
